The animal has a slender, elongated body, short rounded ears, dark eyes, and a pointed snout. Its front paws are held close to its chest. The background is blurred natural vegetation.

Two small, dark, bead-like eyes are clearly visible and symmetrically placed.
The ears are visible as small, rounded protrusions on the sides of the head, consistent with weasel anatomy.

The forelimbs are short and held against the chest; the hind limbs support the body but appear proportionally short relative to the torso length.
